race.comment: BEL MERCI (10) underrated mare who was stakes placed in the G3 Peter Le Grand last February. Proven first up and looks to be back in great shape judging by her two slick trials. Can stalk the fast speed and put these away. COMPENSATION (4) lightly raced gelding building a solid wining CV. Knocked up late from the wide draw first up to finish fourth over this journey at Randwick in BM84 class. Winning jockey hops aboard and expected to figure prominently. BRUCE I AM (6) has gone to a new level this prep and undefeated in three starts at this trip. Sat off the fast speed and rounded them up with ease over 1000m at Randwick in BM84 grade. Makes plenty of appeal again. BENEVAC (3) consistent gelding resuming who maps well with Rawiller aboard. Two searching trials should have him forward enough for this. BLUE AKOYA (11) racing well in easier company and can give plenty of cheek at this level.
